record_title: Vertex corners and isotropy point masses in Kumjian–Pask algebras
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The Steinberg-corner reduction, open-singleton isotropy corner, Kumjian–Pask line-point criterion, and standard source-fiber isotropy induction are prior work and are not claimed as new. The novelty claim is restricted to diagnosing the two universal assertions in arXiv:2609.20230v1, giving their exact missing hypotheses and unital-module repair, and exhibiting explicit counterexamples including contradictions with examples in that preprint. No public correction or revised version of the recent v1 was located. The record does not assess results independent of those constructions.
